get.summary: Poll students presence in a class
get.description: Return students in a class with computed presence status based on last_seen_at. Requires teacher JWT.

403.description: Not allowed (teacher not linked to class / tenant mismatch)

post.description: Accept token (or qr_token). Return JWT + student + user (without secrets).

post.summary: Mark student as recently active (last seen) or offline (best-effort)
post.description: Update student.last_seen_at (throttled by server, e.g. once per 30 seconds). If status="offline", server forces last_seen_at older than threshold so presence becomes offline immediately.

get.summary: List classes of current teacher (active academic year only, paginated)
get.description: Return classes assigned to the currently authenticated teacher, restricted to the tenant's ACTIVE academic year. Supports pagination for infinite scroll. Stop fetching when `page >= meta.pagination.pageCount` or when `data.length === 0`.

403.description: Not allowed (authenticated user is not linked to a teacher record, or teacher has no tenant school_admin link).

post.summary: Upload a project (.sjr + optional thumbnail) and create Project record
post.description: Multipart upload endpoint. Server detects owner_type based on authenticated user: teacher -> owner_type=teacher, otherwise student -> owner_type=student. Stores media in S3/localstack via Strapi upload provider.

403.description: Not allowed (user is not linked to teacher/student record)

get.description: Teacher gets teacher-owned projects, student gets student-owned projects. Supports pagination via pagination[page] & pagination[pageSize].

403.description: Not allowed (user is not linked to teacher/student record)

put.summary: Edit a project (multipart) - replace sjr_file/thumbnail and/or update fields
put.description: Path param {id} is project documentId. Only project owner (teacher/student) can edit. If sjr_file is uploaded, project.sjr_file is replaced. Note: class-assignment snapshots (assigned_*) are not modified.

post.summary: Teacher assigns 1..n teacher projects to 1 class
post.description: Body contains class documentId and an array of teacher project documentIds. Server validates: class belongs to teacher, class is in active academic year, projects belong to teacher (owner_type=teacher). Server snapshots assigned_sjr_file/assigned_title/assigned_thumbnail at assign time so later project edits do not affect students.

400.description: ValidationError (invalid class/projectIds, no active AY, etc.)

403.description: Not allowed (not a teacher, tenant mismatch, etc.)

get.summary: Teacher lists class assignments they created
get.description: Optional query: ?class=<classDocumentId> to filter. Supports pagination via pagination[page] & pagination[pageSize]. Returns snapshot fields assigned_* to show what was assigned at the time.

get.summary: Student lists assignments for their class
get.description: Returns class assignments where class = student's current class. Student must use assigned_sjr_file (snapshot) instead of project.sjr_file. Supports pagination via pagination[page] & pagination[pageSize].

post.summary: Student submits a project to a class assignment
post.description: Path param {id} is class-assignment documentId. Body contains student project documentId. Server validates class membership and project ownership (owner_type=student). Upserts submission by (student + class_assignment).

400.description: ValidationError (missing params/body, student has no class, invalid project, etc.)

403.description: Not allowed (not in class, not student, etc.)

online_count.description: Online students in the whole class (not paginated)

total_count.description: Total students in the whole class (not paginated)

status.description: Optional presence hint. If omitted, defaults to "online". Use "offline" when app is backgrounded/logged out (best-effort).

updated.description: True if last_seen_at was updated in DB; false if throttled (e.g. called within 30s window). For status="offline", usually true.

studentsCount.description: Number of students currently assigned to this class

data.description: Classes of the current teacher in the ACTIVE academic year only (paginated). If there is no active academic year, returns an empty array.

ClassMyQuery.description: Pagination params for infinite scroll. Use querystring format only: `?pagination[page]=1&pagination[pageSize]=10`.

size.description: File size reported by upload plugin (often KB, may be float)

url.description: Public URL (built using baseUrl) or origin URL

size.description: File size reported by upload plugin (often KB, may be float)

url.description: Public URL (built using baseUrl) or origin URL

data.description: List projects owned by current user (teacher or student)

sjr_file.description: .sjr file (optional). If provided, replaces current sjr_file

thumbnail.description: thumbnail (optional). If provided, replaces current thumbnail

sjr_file.description: Project sjr file (optional populate). NOTE: students should use assigned_sjr_file from class-assignment (snapshot) instead.

allOf.description: Snapshot sjr file at assign time (student must use this)
Source teacher project (may be edited later; student should not rely on project.sjr_file)
Snapshot sjr file at assign time (student must use this)

data.description: Created or existing class-assignment rows (duplicates skipped)
Assignments for student's current class (uses snapshot fields assigned_*)

student.description: Populated student (shape depends on your populate)

class_assignment.description: Populated class-assignment (optional; includes assigned_* snapshot fields)
